hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path", ""))'); REPO=/home/robofi/codes/phosphobot; case "$f" in "$REPO"/phosphobot/*.py|"$REPO"/phosphobot/**/*.py) (cd "$REPO/phosphobot" && uv run --quiet ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" && uv run --quiet ruff format --quiet "$f") ;; "$REPO"/dashboard/*|"$REPO"/dashboard/**/*|"$REPO"/dataset-viewer/*|"$REPO"/dataset-viewer/**/*|"$REPO"/cloud/frontend/*|"$REPO"/cloud/frontend/**/*) case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.md) d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "$REPO" ] && [ ! -f "$d/package.json" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/package.json" ] && (cd "$d" && npx --no-install prettier --write --log-level=warn "$f") ;; esac ;; esac
